meta.method:
Calibrate the Super Sejong lexical resources on real Korean text.

Inputs (all local, read-only):
  KatFish dataset  research/B/katfish_repo/katfish_dataset/{essay,abstract,poetry}.jsonl  (label 0=human, 1=LLM)
  Naver news       research/B/naver_news_test.csv  (human, professional)
  KLUE-MRC ctx     research/B/klue_mrc_ctx.json    (human, wiki/news/etc.)
Outputs: five JSON resource files + calibration_summary.json in --out.

Method
  * hits per 10k characters per corpus group (regex finditer, non-overlapping)
  * log-odds ratio with informative Dirichlet prior (Monroe, Colaresi & Quinn 2008, "Fightin' Words"):
      delta = log((yL+a)/(nL+a0-yL-a)) - log((yH+a)/(nH+a0-yH-a)),  var ~ 1/(yL+a)+1/(yH+a),  z = delta/sqrt(var)
    exposure n is the number of characters, a_w = a0 * p_bg(w) with p_bg = hits per character in the background
    (human news + KLUE), a0 = A0 pseudo-characters. Computed per genre and combined by inverse-variance weighting
    (stratified, so genre mix differences between human and LLM sets do not leak into the score).
  * document-level bootstrap (resample docs within genre x class) for a 95% interval of the stratified delta
